segments.he: תַּרְנְגוֹלֶת שֶׁבָּרְחָה וְכוּ׳. דּוֹחִין — אִין, מְדַדִּין — לָא. תְּנֵינָא לְהָא, דְתָנוּ רַבָּנַן: מְדַדִּין בְּהֵמָה חַיָּה וָעוֹף בֶּחָצֵר, אֲבָל לֹא אֶת הַתַּרְנְגוֹלֶת.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: With regard to «a hen that fled» that one seeks to retrieve, he may push it back to its place. By inference: «Push» the hen, «yes,» it is permitted, «help» it «to walk, no,» it is prohibited. The Gemara comments: «We» already «learned this, as the Sages taught: One may help domesticated animals, non-domesticated animals, and fowl walk in the courtyard» on Shabbat, «but not hens.»
